coreMemory.english: v. to think that something will probably happen；v. to require or believe that someone should do something
coreMemory.structure: expect something /ɪkˈspekt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（预料某事）；expect to do something /ɪkˈspekt ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（预计会做某事）；expect someone to do something /ɪkˈspekt ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（期望某人做某事）；expect that + clause /ɪkˈspekt ˈðæt ˈklɔːz/（预计某事发生）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ expect that he will to come → ✅ expect that he will come / expect him to come；❌ I expect you helping me with the move. → ✅ I expect you to help me with the move.

commonErrors.wrong: expect that he will to come
commonErrors.right: expect that he will come / expect him to come
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ɪkˈspekt ˈðæt ˈhiː ˈwɪl ˈkʌm ɪkˈspekt ˈhɪm ˈtuː ˈkʌm/
commonErrors.note: expect 可接 that 从句或 expect someone to do，不可在 will 后再加 to

commonErrors.wrong: I expect you helping me with the move.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ɪkˈspekt ˈjuː ˈhɛlpɪŋ ˈmiː ˈwɪð ðə ˈmuːv/
commonErrors.right: I expect you to help me with the move.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ɪkˈspekt ˈjuː ˈtuː ˈhɛlp ˈmiː ˈwɪð ðə ˈmuːv/
commonErrors.note: expect 表示要求或预期某人做事时用 expect someone to do，不接宾语后直接用 doing

coreMemory.directSynonym: anticipate /ænˈtɪsəˌpeɪt/（预期）；predict /prɪˈdɪkt/（预测）；await /əˈweɪt/（等待）；require /ˌriːˈkwaɪɚ/（要求）；suppose /səˈpoʊz/（认为；料想）
coreMemory.derivatives: expectation · expectancy · expected · unexpected · expectant · unexpectedly
coreMemory.example: We expect the results next week.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我们预计下周会有结果。

meanings.english: to think that something will probably happen
to require or believe that someone should do something
meanings.example: Parents expect the school to keep children safe.
meanings.translation: 家长要求学校保障孩子安全。

items.phrase: expect a reply within a week
expect staff to arrive on time
be expected to follow the rules

items.chinese: 要求供应商达到高标准
要做好意外发生的准备

items.phrase: expect the worst but hope for the best
items.phonetic: /ɪkˈspekt ðə ˈwɝːst ˈbʌt ˈhoʊp ˈfɔːr ðə ˈbɛst/
items.chinese: 做最坏打算，抱最好希望

fixedPhrases.example: We expect heavy traffic on Friday evening.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们预计周五晚间交通拥堵。

fixedPhrases.example: We expect to finish the repairs within two weeks.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们预计两周内完成维修。

fixedPhrases.example: I expect every driver to follow the safety rules.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我要求每名驾驶员都遵守安全规定。

fixedPhrases.example: Analysts expect that prices will stabilize soon.
fixedPhrases.translation: 分析人士预计价格很快会稳定。

fixedPhrases.example: Customers expect clear information from the airline.
fixedPhrases.translation: 顾客期待航空公司提供清晰信息。

fixedPhrases.example: I expect a reply by the end of the week.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我期待本周结束前收到回复。

fixedPhrases.example: As expected, the coastal road was busy.
fixedPhrases.translation: 不出所料，沿海道路很拥挤。

fixedPhrases.chinese: 会发生什么；该期待什么
fixedPhrases.example: The guide explains what to expect during the interview.
fixedPhrases.translation: 指南说明了面试期间会遇到什么。

fixedPhrases.example: Prepare for delays, but do not automatically expect the worst.
fixedPhrases.translation: 为延误做好准备，但不要自动作最坏打算。

fixedPhrases.phrase: be widely expected to do something
fixedPhrases.example: The central bank is widely expected to hold rates steady.
fixedPhrases.translation: 外界普遍预计央行将维持利率不变。

fixedPhrases.example: Help arrived when we least expected it.
fixedPhrases.translation: 帮助在我们最意想不到时到来了。

fixedPhrases.example: Customers expected more than the basic package could deliver.
fixedPhrases.translation: 顾客的期待高于基础套餐的实际表现。

synonyms.difference: 较正式，常含提前准备之意；预期概率、规范要求和等待来访者的含义不可混用
强调根据证据判断未来；预期概率、规范要求和等待来访者的含义不可混用
只对应 expecting a baby/visitor 等等待义
只对应 expect someone to meet a standard 的规范义
把握较弱，常用于非正式推测；预期概率、规范要求和等待来访者的含义不可混用

derivatives.note: 常见于 meet/exceed expectations
常见于 life expectancy（预期寿命），也可指期待某事发生的状态。
指按计划或推测可能出现的
形容事件、结果或来访者未被预料到，而非单纯不受欢迎
可形容满怀期待的人，也常见于 expectant mother/parent。
修饰意外发生的动作或结果

confusables.difference: expect 表示根据信息认为某事很可能发生；hope 表示希望好事发生，不代表判断概率

commonErrors.right: The price fell / The price has fallen
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ðə ˈpraɪs ˈfɛl ðə ˈpraɪs ˈhæz ˈfɑlən/

meanings.english: to decrease in amount, level, or quality

items.phrase: the holiday falls on a Monday

fixedPhrases.example: A branch fell to the ground during the storm.
fixedPhrases.translation: 暴风雨中一根树枝落到了地上。

fixedPhrases.example: The phone fell from the balcony but did not break.
fixedPhrases.translation: 手机从阳台掉下，但没有摔坏。

fixedPhrases.example: Average prices fell by eight percent.
fixedPhrases.translation: 平均价格下降了百分之八。

fixedPhrases.example: Nighttime temperatures fell to minus five.
fixedPhrases.translation: 夜间气温降到零下五度。

fixedPhrases.example: The child fell asleep during the journey.
fixedPhrases.translation: 孩子在旅途中睡着了。

fixedPhrases.example: Several crew members fell ill after the voyage.
fixedPhrases.translation: 航程结束后几名船员病倒了。

fixedPhrases.example: Students who miss practice may fall behind.
fixedPhrases.translation: 缺少练习的学生可能会落后。

fixedPhrases.example: The cardboard box fell apart in the rain.
fixedPhrases.translation: 纸箱在雨中散架了。

fixedPhrases.example: Most cases fall into one of three categories.
fixedPhrases.translation: 多数案例属于三个类别之一。

fixedPhrases.example: They fell in love while studying in Rome.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们在罗马求学时相爱了。

fixedPhrases.example: The deal fell through when the bank withdrew financing.
fixedPhrases.translation: 银行撤回融资后，交易告吹。

fixedPhrases.example: The response fell short of what residents had requested.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这一回应未达到居民的要求。

synonyms.difference: 强调突然且幅度很大的下落或数值下降，不用于普通缓慢下降

常用于数量、质量或健康逐渐降低；物体下落、数值下降与进入状态的主语限制不同
强调突然、不受控制；物体下落、数值下降与进入状态的主语限制不同
强调支撑失效而倒下；物体下落、数值下降与进入状态的主语限制不同

antonyms.usage: 与向下掉落或数值下降相反；物体下落、数值下降与进入状态的主语限制不同

derivatives.note: 常用 the fallout from something 指争端、决定或事故带来的负面后果。

examples.english: Our van broke down outside the village.
examples.chinese: 我们的面包车在村外抛锚了。

examples.english: A fire broke out in the warehouse overnight.
examples.chinese: 夜间仓库突然起火。

examples.english: The band broke up after its final tour.
examples.chinese: 乐队在最后一次巡演后解散了。

examples.english: The doctor gently broke the news to the family.
examples.chinese: 医生委婉地把消息告诉了家属。

studyFocus.coreMeaning: 先掌握“打破；弄坏”这个核心义，再对比另外 2 个常用义项，辨别不同语境。
studyFocus.keyCollocation: 把“break a rule”连同介词、宾语和动词形式作为整个句块记忆。
studyFocus.commonMistake: be broken 表示处于损坏状态；break down 是不及物短语，不用 is broken down 表达简单故障
studyFocus.mustUseExample: Do not break the rule just because the task feels difficult.（不要因为任务困难就违反规则。）
